name: phase6-risk-geometry
note: This file IS the experiment specification. It was written BEFORE any Phase 6 measurement and is READ by scripts/v2/geometry*.mjs: no axis, range, weight, gate or horizon is hardcoded in JS. Phase 6 searches ONLY execution geometry (hold time, stop distance, target distance, trailing). Strategy thresholds, sides, market scope, leverage and exit ORDER are frozen.
hardRules: no randomness: explicit finite configuration list, deterministic ordering, identical input -> identical output
no look-ahead: a trade is resolved ONLY on bars strictly after its decision bar; parameter selection uses TRAIN only
CONTROL geometry is always inside the tested set and is never rewritten
leverage is NOT an axis (risk parameter, fixed at CONTROL)
strategy thresholds are NOT an axis (Phase 5 owns them; CONTROL signals are re-used unchanged)
every tested configuration is persisted, including failures (no silent discards)
the TEST fold is evaluated once, after the geometry is frozen
missing evidence is reported as INSUFFICIENT, never as zero
the live engine, the survival gate and the learner are untouched; geometry outputs live under data/calibration and config/risk.experimental.json

frozenAxes.leverage: CONTROL (config.json v2.leverage maxLeverage + strategies.mjs baseLev, market-capped by candidateLeverage)
frozenAxes.strategyParams: CONTROL (config/strategies.control.json — Phase 5 CONTROL, byte-compared by tests)
frozenAxes.exitOrder: liquidation -> stop-loss -> take-profit -> time-stop -> trailing-stop (engine.mjs managePositions)
frozenAxes.costModel: perp.mjs: taker fee on both legs, half-spread + sqrt market impact adversely on both fills
frozenAxes.marginModel: isolated, marginUsd fixed, no wallet/concurrency/council gates (counterfactual dataset)
frozenAxes.funding: OMITTED (no historical funding rate offline) — bias documented, never filled in with a guess

daily.role: daily bar context for the four daily-signal strategies (tsmom, donchian, rsi2dip, mom_trend)

hour.role: PRIMARY geometry panel for the four daily-signal strategies

quarter.role: intraday strategies keep the Phase 5 panel because their session/range semantics need sub-hour bars (orb: 30-minute opening range; ibreakout: 48x15m breakout)

holdHours.rationale: does the edge emerge after the current 4h horizon, or is 4h already too long?

stopScale.unit: multiple of the strategy's OWN CONTROL stopPct
stopScale.rationale: pure stop-distance effect. Scaling (not replacing) preserves each strategy's own risk unit.

bounds.note: a scaled stop outside these bounds is invalid and the config is rejected

targetScale.unit: multiple of the strategy's OWN CONTROL targetPct

trailing.note: trailing is only meaningful at longer holds: the trailing axis is applied ONLY on the 24h hold (pre-registered), where the CONTROL trailing could ever activate.

configurations.rationale: production geometry (must remain an option; never modified)
long hold + tight stop + far target
trailing only: is the CONTROL trail cutting the long-hold move short?

resolutionModel.note: Offline counterfactual resolution reusing perp.mjs (identical cost model to Phase 5) with the pre-registered geometry plugged in. Documented differences from the live engine/shadow layer: (1) bars, not 30s quotes; (2) CONSERVATIVE intra-bar ordering — liquidation, then stop before target when both levels are touched in the same bar; (3) the stop fills at min/max(stopLevel, barOpen), never better than the stop; (4) time/trailing fill at the EMA mark; (5) NO funding accrual; (6) the entry is the decision bar close plus an adverse fill.
resolutionModel.stopFill: at the stop level, never worse (gap-aware)
resolutionModel.targetFill: at the target level, never better
resolutionModel.timeTrailFill: at the EMA mark (alpha = risk.control.json markEmaAlpha)
resolutionModel.maeMfe: from intra-bar extremes against isolated margin; reported both inside the actual hold and over the fixed diagnostic horizon

costSeparation.note: Phase 6 splits reward into three layers so 'the strategy has no directional edge' and 'the edge exists but costs eat it' can never be confused.
costSeparation.raw_ret_pct: pure price return from the decision bar close to the exit reference price (no fills, no fees) x side sign
costSeparation.gross_pnl_usd: fill-to-fill P&L (adverse entry fill and adverse exit fill included => spread and slippage are embedded here), fees excluded
costSeparation.fees_usd: taker fee on entry notional + taker fee on exit notional
costSeparation.spread_slip_usd: gross_pnl_usd minus the P&L computed at the un-adjusted reference prices (what the two adverse fills cost)
costSeparation.R_own: net_pnl / (qty * entry * this geometry's stopPct) — standard own-risk R
costSeparation.R_ctrl: net_pnl / (qty * entry * the strategy's CONTROL stopPct) — CROSS-GEOMETRY comparable risk unit and the primary comparison unit, because net_pnl and margin are identical across geometries
costSeparation.break_even_move_pct: (fees_usd + spread_slip_usd) / entry notional — the favourable price move needed to pay for one round trip

diagnostics.censoring: if the panel ends before a horizon, the value is null and the count is reported as censored — never filled, never zero
diagnostics.unconditionalExcursion: excursions and time-to-event are measured over the diagnostic horizon REGARDLESS of the trade's own geometry (diagnostic measurement only; the trade itself is unchanged)

objective.note: Geometry-ecosystem quality, NOT maximum historical return. Turnover is never rewarded (availability is capped at 1 = parity with CONTROL) and thin samples are neutral.
objective.tieBreak: highest score wins; equal scores are broken by lexicographic configuration id (deterministic)

validationGate.note: A geometry replaces CONTROL only if it is NOT materially worse on the VALIDATION fold and does not collapse availability. Failures are recorded with the reason; the TRAIN-best geometry is NOT used when it fails.

sufficiency.policy: a metric below these sample sizes is reported as INSUFFICIENT and is never converted to 0, never silently dropped and never used to declare an edge

profitabilityGuard: A positive TEST mean net R would NOT establish profitability. Phase 6 reports four separate claims: RAW EDGE (price return), NET EDGE (after costs), ROBUST OUT-OF-SAMPLE EDGE (TEST fold) and PROFITABILITY (which requires a separate standard: capital, sizing, concurrency, episodes, drawdown, funding and live execution).
frozenBySemantics: a strategy's KIND never changes: trend stays trend, breakout stays breakout, mean reversion stays mean reversion
side rules never change (mom_trend stays long-only; no synthetic shorts)
signal thresholds and market scope never change
only holdHours / stopScale / targetScale / trailing are searched, and stop/target are applied as multiples of each strategy's OWN CONTROL values so the risk unit stays meaningful
